rationale: PRD covers core requirements well with clear problem definition and user stories. Minor gaps in requirement traceability and success metric baselines.

categories.name: Problem Definition
categories.rationale: Clear 4-point problem statement with specific pain points (no workflow context, no synthesis guidance, no evaluation, fragmented tooling)

categories.name: Goals and Non-Goals
categories.rationale: Solution section defines scope; explicit Out of Scope section covers non-goals well

categories.name: User Stories
categories.rationale: 7 agent stories + 3 PM stories in proper format; good role coverage

categories.name: Requirements
categories.rationale: MCP Tool Design table is functional but requirements aren't numbered/traceable; no REQ-IDs

categories.name: Success Metrics
categories.rationale: 3 metrics with targets (80%, 40%, 60%) but no baselines or measurement methods specified

findings.message: Add numbered requirement IDs (REQ-001, REQ-002) for traceability
Add baselines ('currently X%, target Y%') and measurement method
Consider adding acceptance criteria per story
